en.name: Chorizo, smoked and uncooked
en.summary: Smoked but uncooked chorizo has been through the smokehouse at a temperature that adds flavour without cooking it, so it still has to be cooked before eating. It keeps about 1 week at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: This one is a refrigerated product, and the smoke is the reason people get it wrong: smoke flavour is not preservation. Because the sausage has not been cooked and has not been dried to the point of shelf stability, it belongs in the fridge from the shop to the pan. Out of the cold it is bound by the two-hour rule, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use it within about 1 week of purchase, or by the printed date if that is sooner. Store it low in the fridge, on a tray, and treat it as raw meat: separate board, separate tongs, hands washed after handling, and nothing ready to eat stored underneath it. Cook it right through — browning the skin of a thick link does not get the centre there.
en.freezer: It keeps 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality, wrapped link by link and bagged with the air pressed out. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are quality limits, and past them the fat oxidises and the smoke tastes acrid rather than sweet. Label the bag, because frozen smoked chorizo looks exactly like the cooked kind.
en.thawing: Thaw overnight in the fridge, or in a sealed bag under cold running water and cook straight away. Never on the counter. If it thawed fully at room temperature, cook it rather than refreezing it.
spoilage: A sour or ammonia smell coming through the smoke.
Slime on the casing or a tacky feel to the surface.
Grey-green discolouration in the filling rather than just on the skin.
A leaking, puffy or vacuum-lost pack.
tips: Check the label for the word cooked; the cooked version keeps far longer and this one does not.
Freeze in single links so you can cook one without thawing the lot.
Poach thick links gently before frying if you struggle to get the centre cooked.
Keep it below and away from salad, cheese and anything else eaten cold.

faq.q: How long does uncooked smoked chorizo keep in the fridge?
faq.a: About 1 week at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or the printed date if that comes first.

faq.q: Can you eat smoked chorizo without cooking it?
faq.a: Not this one. Smoked and uncooked means it has been flavoured but not cooked, so it must be cooked all the way through.

faq.q: Can you freeze smoked uncooked chorizo?
faq.a: Yes, 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Wrap the links individually and label the bag.

zh.name: 煙燻生西班牙臘腸
zh.summary: 煙燻但未熟製的 chorizo，只是在燻房裡用不會把它燻熟的溫度增添風味，所以吃之前仍然必須煮熟。冷藏 4 °C 以下約 1 週，冷凍 −18 °C 下 1～2 個月。
zh.pantry: 這是冷藏品，而「煙燻」正是最多人誤會的地方：煙燻香氣不等於保存效果。它既沒熟製、也沒有乾燥到能常溫穩定的程度，所以從店裡到下鍋前都該待在冰箱。離開冷藏後受 2 小時原則規範，室溫超過 32 °C 時縮為 1 小時。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下，購買後約 1 週內用完，若包裝日期更早則以標示為準。放冰箱下層並墊托盤，完全當生肉處理：獨立砧板、獨立夾子、處理後洗手，下方不要放任何即食食品。要煮透——粗的香腸把外皮煎上色，中心其實還沒到溫度。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下品質可維持 1～2 個月，一條一條包好、裝袋壓出空氣。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數只是品質期限；超過之後油脂氧化，煙燻味會從甘轉成嗆。袋子記得標示，因為冷凍後它和熟製版本長得一模一樣。
zh.thawing: 冷藏隔夜解凍，或密封裝袋用冷水沖、沖完立刻煮。不要放室溫退冰。若已在室溫下完全退冰，請煮熟而不要再冷凍。
spoilage: 在煙燻味底下聞到酸味或氨味。
腸衣發黏，表面摸起來黏手。
內餡出現灰綠色，而不只是外皮變色。
包裝滲液、脹袋或真空跑掉。
tips: 看清楚標示有沒有「熟製」字樣；熟製版耐放很多，這款不是。
一條一條冷凍，才不用為了一條解凍一整包。
粗香腸不好煮熟的話，先小火水煮再煎。
放在生菜、起司等所有冷食的下方並保持距離。

faq.q: 煙燻生 chorizo 冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下約 1 週，若包裝日期更早則以包裝為準。

faq.q: 煙燻 chorizo 可以不煮直接吃嗎？
faq.a: 這款不行。煙燻但未熟製代表只加了風味沒煮熟，必須整條煮透。

faq.q: 煙燻生 chorizo 可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，−18 °C 下 1～2 個月品質最好。一條一條包好並在袋上標示。
